title: Guard Your Time
devotional: Your time is one of the most valuable things God has placed in your hands. What you repeatedly do with your time eventually becomes part of your life. When your days are filled with endless distractions, boredom can create space for temptation to grow. This does not mean every moment must be productive. Rest matters too. But intentional living means knowing where your time is going and making room for what truly matters. Today, look at your routine and identify where you are losing time that could be used to strengthen your body, mind, relationships, or walk with God.
mind_check: Where do you regularly lose the most time without realizing it?
body_move: Choose one period of wasted time today and replace it with a healthy physical activity such as walking, stretching, exercising, or organizing your space.
spirit_move: Set aside a specific time today for prayer or Scripture. Protect that time instead of allowing distractions to take it away.
way_out: When I notice myself wasting time on __________, I will use that time for __________ instead.
prayer: Father, help me become wise with the time You have given me. Show me where distractions are controlling my attention and help me create better habits. Teach me to make room for prayer, Scripture, healthy activity, meaningful relationships, rest, and work that honors You. Amen.
action: Look at your typical day and identify one hour or period that is often wasted. Decide exactly how you will use that time differently tomorrow.
